user.title: Basic Configuration
user.description:
Configure basic ISP health monitoring settings. This integration tracks your internet connection quality, speed, and reliability. All core features work without API keys using free services.

**Rate Limits:**
• ip-api.com: 45 requests/minute (free)
• ipinfo.io: 50,000 requests/month (free), unlimited with token
• ipgeolocation.io: Requires API key (paid service)

data.ip_info_token: API Token (optional for higher rate limits)

core_sensors.title: Core Sensors Configuration
core_sensors.description: Configure core sensors that provide basic network information. These sensors are always enabled and provide essential connectivity data.

extended_sensors.title: Extended Sensors Configuration
extended_sensors.description: Configure extended sensors that provide detailed network analysis. Enable only what you need to avoid unnecessary resource usage.

throughput.title: Speed Test Configuration
throughput.description:
Configure speed testing with advanced options to minimize bandwidth usage and control when tests run.

**Features:**
• Time window scheduling to avoid peak hours
• Separate upload/download test control
• Organization-based filtering for ISP-specific rules
